title: [agent] High-risk gate test
body:
### Pre-flight checklist

- [x] This task has been discussed and approved by a maintainer (Discord or otherwise)
- [x] I understand this task will be implemented by an AI agent (Codex) and reviewed by an AI agent (Claude Code)
- [x] I understand a human maintainer must approve the plan before implementation begins

### Goal

Verify that high-risk tasks cannot enter automated planning.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The task is classified as risk:high
- [ ] Admission transitions to ai:forbidden

### Context / Background

Stage 4 high-risk gate fixture.

### Constraints

- Do not invoke a model

### Risk Level

risk:high — auth, data, migration, or deployment

### Relevant Files or Modules

.github/workflows/ai-issue-triage.yml

### Discussion or Approval Reference

Maintainer-approved high-risk regression fixture.

### Scope Acknowledgment

- [x] This task does NOT involve authentication, authorization, secrets, database migrations, production config, release versioning, or branch protection changes
